title: Control plane event
description: Events the shared workflow POSTs to the control plane at /events, signed with HMAC-SHA256 over the body (X-Control-Signature: sha256=<hex>). GitHub webhooks carry the rest.

bundle.description: The build.json record, or null when the build failed before producing one.

artifact_url.description: Workflow artifact holding the bundle for dev/pr builds.

pages.description: The repository's Pages deploy in this run (CONVENTIONS §6, "Repo Pages"), made before this event is sent: `deployed` when a live release's site went out with this release in it; `failed` when it was attempted and every deploy failed, so the site still serves the previous deploy without this release (repaired by the next release or a `reason: pages` run); `skipped` when the run made no release and attempted none. Absent from events of workflows older than contracts 1.10.
